question: Conditional pipeline effect of error location under matched error type/count/whole-graph scores,including refitting and action choice;not pure universal causal effect of location

hypotheses.primary: H1:mu=E_structure[L(G_key)-L(G_peripheral)]>0 with a materially relevant mean >=0.1 on scale1
hypotheses.negative: mu<0 and sufficiently negative is legitimate counterevidence
hypotheses.null_and_ties: mu near0 and individual pair ties are valid outcomes;no posthoc pair selection
hypotheses.not_tested: metric ranking,causal discovery algorithm comparison,TEP recovery/safety

reference_generation.population: New mechanisms/data streams independent conditional on accepted unique topology catalogue;fixed family quotas and exclusion against already accepted topologies constrain exchangeability. Not an unconstrained iid DAG or manufacturing sample.
reference_generation.nodes: n uniform integer8..10 for each candidate;roles R,S,P,Q,A,M1,M2,Y plus n-8 extra Z nodes
reference_generation.optional_edges: For every not-backbone forward pair in canonical topological order,include independently withp=.2 ONLY if source is R,S,P,Q or Z. No optional outgoing edges from A,M1,M2,Y. Reject if totalE>2n or weakly disconnected,never trim based on outcomes.
reference_generation.density: E8..20;density E/(n(n-1)/2).S has one indirect route,P has direct+twoindirect routes;optional upstream parents do not add A-descendant routes.
reference_generation.coefficient: Independent fair sign times Uniform(0.4,1.0) on each accepted direct edge;zero intercept. Never screen on total effect,sign,cancellation,optimum or trained results.
reference_generation.noise: mutually independent Uniform(-1,1),independent of policy assignment and training/validation streams;linear additive fully observed
reference_generation.action_target: A and Y by scaffold roles before coefficients;one task per SCM. Random column permutation is encoding only,not a new SCM.
reference_generation.novelty: Reject unlabeled directed isomorphism to any S1..S8/C01..C12 or already accepted new graph. Also reject same-node-count candidates isomorphic after <=1 directed-edge insertion/deletion/reversal;acyclic graphs only. Record all candidate IDs/rejection reasons. Different coefficients or relabelling alone do not establish new topology.
reference_generation.acceptance: Before observational sampling/fits:full node/edge declarations valid and acyclic;E bound;weak connectivity;novelty;at leastone eligible deletion pair andone eligible reversal pair. No outcome/fit/choice/loss screening.
reference_generation.pool: For each family enumerate candidate IDs1..10000;take first15 passing static criteria.No extension of pool or reduced cohort if quota cannot be filled;record generation gate failure.
reference_generation.seeds: No draws now.Each future stream seed=uint32(first4bytes SHA256(UTF8("ERROR-LOC-v1|20261029|family|candidate_id|stream|repeat"))).Stream names topology,coefficients,column_order,train,validation;repeat1..3 only for data.Enumerate and reject namespace collision before any draws;collision resolution uses recorded|retry=k suffix,not outcome-driven reseeding.
reference_generation.prior_data: S/C are design-only.No existing sample rows,models,do arrays or C12 confirmation outcomes reused as new observations.

pair_contract.reference_core: K=union of all true directed A->Y path edges for THIS task
pair_contract.peripheral: P=E_truth minus K,including other ancestors of Y or A;outside A-path does NOT mean causally irrelevant to fitting or Y
pair_contract.enumeration: For each type enumerate ALL ordered(core-edge,peripheral-edge) combinations with same reference;construct G_key and G_peripheral separately. No mixing types/no result-based cap.
pair_contract.structural_ineligibility: If either reversed graph cyclic,self-loop,duplicate opposite edge,or score/count mismatch,reject before data/fitting and record reason.Never break cycles to make pair fit.
pair_contract.score_formula: m true edges:deletion F1s=2(m-1)/(2m-1),SHD1,E=m-1;reversal skeletonF1=1,strictF1=(m-1)/m,SHD1,E=m.All controlled graphs fully directed;no GT orientation of learner outputs.
pair_contract.universe: all unordered nodepairs for skeleton;all ordered distinct pairs for direction;reference is the prespecified generating DAG of this synthetic SCM only
pair_contract.dedup: Canonical sorted edge lists for BOTH graphs with sourceSCM/task/type;exclude identical G_key/G_peripheral and collapse synonymous labels.Both graphs get stable content hashes.Count nominal,static rejected,distinct,task-valid separately.
pair_contract.path_subgroups: Primary includes disconnected and retained pairs.Secondary retained:at leastone original reference A->Y directed path survives in BOTH graphs,not merely a spurious new reachable path.Record original path fraction and any graph reachability separately.Pfamily supports retained subgroup;Sfamily has none for core-edge edits.
pair_contract.reuse: Fit each distinct controlled graph once per SCM/data repeat;reuse response/recommendation across its pair appearances.No duplicate fit is a new independent graph sample.
pair_contract.artificial: GT is used deliberately to create controlled errors;not actual causal-discovery outputs and never mixed into algorithm performance.

fitting.preprocessing: train-only centering/scaling;all variables observed;shared train/validation draws in a pair
fitting.model: existing integrated_pilot.fit_model linear Ridge,alpha0.01 fixed;all nodes receive same rule
fitting.selection: No hyperparameter/model/policy selection.Validation is observational-MSE diagnostic only,not task rejection or tuning.
fitting.coefficients: reestimated on the same training rows for each graph;changes in fit are part of the conditional pipeline contrast
fitting.model_failure: Record precise graph/fit/response/recommendation failure;do not repair using truth.Use reference action0 as explicit operational fallback.In operational primary all eligible pairs remain,including failures;report fit-available conditional analysis separately.
fitting.oracle_diagnostic: One true-graph Ridge per dataset included in upper budget as diagnostic only;no effect on graph eligibility/alpha/task/recommendation selection and never counted as discovered graph.

task.policy: confirmed_only,existing no-path baseline fallback;no minimax/abstention comparison in this experiment
task.tie_rule: Candidates within1e-12 of minimum objective considered tied;choose smallestabs(a),then smaller signed a.Record tie set,not a spurious independent best.
task.nondegeneracy: Positive/negative coefficients and direct/indirect routes permit different responses;actual choice variation UNKNOWN before execution.No rejection for nearzero total effect,baseline-optimal tasks,identical actions or identical losses.

outcomes.structural: paired score/count equality,core/peripheral labels,reference-path survival and estimated reachability
outcomes.fixed_effect: predict mean do(A=.5)-mean do(A=0) for EVERY fit graph without optimization;reference analytic effect;intercept/baseline error separate;sign error excludes |trueeffect|<=1e-8,record zero/missed separately
outcomes.normalization: divide by fixed loss_scale^2=1.No baseline-loss or improvement-gap denominator,no winsorization/clipping of loss or DeltaL.
outcomes.primary: DeltaL=L(G_key)-L(G_peripheral),using actual pipeline choice including predeclared failure fallback.Oracle-best loss cancels within pair but regret stillreported.
report: large deterioration overreference >1 original loss_scale²,all extremes retained
outcomes.model_vs_path: No-path is not fit failure;predicted total effect0 caused by absent directed path is reported separately from nonzero path coefficient error.Not a general causal mediation decomposition.

evaluation.reference: After recommendation freeze,compute exact mean of the SAME declared linear SCM for each5candidate action;no model input sees reference coefficients/effects/outcomes.Model fitting/recommendation and reference evaluator have separate inputs.
evaluation.independent_check: Compare topological substitution means to linear-system solution with intervened row.This is implementation check,not a second independent outcome sample.
evaluation.actual_do: 0 planned for this exact-mean controlled experiment;does not validate a new stochastic simulator or manufacture Recovery/Safety evidence.No row-wise noise alignment assertion.
evaluation.freeze_order: PLAN+budget/gate resolution -> generator+analysis implementation/source hashes -> eligible structures+coefficients/tasks/metadata hash (no observations yet) -> train/validation -> all model outputs/recommendations+hash -> analytic evaluation -> statistical analysis
evaluation.reference_failure: Nonfinite/malformed true SCM or disagreeing analytic methods stops entire cohort;do not impute loss or discard bad reference after results.
evaluation.model_failures: Operational fallback0 is a real action,not missingloss0.Available-only secondary does not replace operational primary.If no functioning pairs remain,report pipeline non-evaluability,not H1 null evidence.
evaluation.evaluation_seed: NOT_APPLICABLE to exact reference means;no stochastic final do panel planned. This is independent of model fitting inputs,not new random outcome evidence.

analysis.unit: independent new referenceSCM;data repeats/pairs/graphs and two error types nested
analysis.aggregation: Within structure:data mean per pair;equal-weight ALL eligible distinct pairs within each error type;then equalweight deletion/reversal.Each structure one S_s.Equalweight two family means,then overall.Identical graph outputs/candidate choices/ties stay in denominator.
analysis.subgroup: Retained original-path pairs secondary;withinfamily eligible units only,report actualSCM count.No0-imputation for missing subgroups;Sfamily is inapplicable,not no effect.
analysis.uncertainty: After separate execution approval:10000 percentile bootstrap draws of whole SCMs within each fixed family quota,including all nested rows;seed derived from ERROR-LOC-v1|20261029|analysis_bootstrap.Family-fixed conditional precision,not manufacturing or unconstrained graph population.Independent row bootstrap forbidden.
analysis.H1_support: Overall mean DeltaL>=0.1 AND stored95%CI lower>0.Stronger claim of material superiority requires lower>0.1 separately.No switching to medians/sign rates after results.
analysis.near_null: If entire CI inside[-.1,.1],describe compatibility with small differences;do not label a formal equivalence test
analysis.otherwise: inconclusive;ties valid;all structure results and failures reported
analysis.secondary: Descriptive retained/broken/partial paths,error types,policy action differences,effect errors,failures and extremes.No confirmatory multiple subgroup claims or p-value hunting.
analysis.precision: BUDGET scenarios are width planning from existing dependent-pair structure aggregates,not new tests/power.Computation and precision gates both must pass before new data.
analysis.uncertainty_limit: Percentile intervals are approximate family-fixed conditional summaries under unique-topology selection,not a proven-coverage interval for an unrestricted population;independence of data/noise seeds does not make every nested row an independent SCM.

implementation: Design only. No runnable execution command or new generator is delivered/claimed. Do not repurpose old run_diverse... to generate this cohort;it does not implement this contract.
next_decision: Resolve precision vs independent-SCM resource commitment (or stop expansion),and whether isolated fit/topology time/memory evidence can support the resulting budget.No automatic follow-up smoke/code/document loop.
